name: MASTER_WINNERFX_GOLD_MT5
summary: This EA is a grid trading system for gold (XAUUSD) that uses EMA trend direction and RSI momentum for initial entries, then adds up to 3 martingale-scaled grid positions at fixed pip intervals when price moves against the trade. All positions are closed when combined profit reaches a target or loss exceeds a maximum risk threshold.
summary_zh: 这是一个针对黄金的网格交易EA，使用EMA趋势方向和RSI动量进行初始入场，当价格反向移动固定点数间隔时，最多追加3个马丁格尔加仓网格头寸。当组合利润达到目标或亏损超过最大风险阈值时，平掉所有仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于趋势跟踪的网格加仓系统，结合EMA判断趋势方向和RSI确认动量后进行初始入场。入场条件为：价格在EMA上方且RSI大于55时做多，价格在EMA下方且RSI小于45时做空。出场条件有两种：一是所有持仓总利润达到TargetProfit时全部平仓，二是总亏损超过MaxRisk时止损平仓。仓位管理采用动态手数，根据账户余额按每1000美元对应LotPer1000计算基础手数，网格加仓时使用Multiplier乘数递增手数，属于马丁格尔式加仓。资金管理方面，通过CanOpenTrade检查可用保证金是否充足，并使用GetSafeLot规范化手数，但最大网格层级被硬编码限制为3层。网格间距固定为GridStep点数，没有设置止损止盈单价位，完全依赖组合盈亏触发平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a trend-following grid pyramiding system that combines EMA for trend direction and RSI for momentum confirmation before initial entry. Entry conditions are: go long when price is above EMA and RSI is above 55, or go short when price is below EMA and RSI is below 45. Exit conditions are twofold: close all positions when total combined profit reaches TargetProfit, or close all when total loss exceeds MaxRisk. Position sizing uses dynamic lots calculated from account balance at LotPer1000 per $1000, and grid additions use a Multiplier factor to increase lot size progressively, making this a martingale-style pyramiding approach. Money management checks free margin via CanOpenTrade before each order and normalizes lot size via GetSafeLot, but the maximum grid level is hard-coded to 3 layers. Grid spacing is fixed at GridStep points, and no individual stop-loss or take-profit price levels are set on any order, relying entirely on combined P&L triggers for exits.

parameters.name: LotPer1000
parameters.description: 每1000美元余额对应的基础手数

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: 网格加仓手数乘数（马丁格尔倍率）

parameters.name: TargetProfit
parameters.description: 组合利润目标（美元），达到后全部平仓
parameters.description_en: Portfolio profit target in USD, close all on reach

parameters.name: MaxRisk
parameters.description: 最大允许亏损（美元），超过后全部平仓
parameters.description_en: Max allowed loss in USD, close all on breach

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于识别本EA的持仓
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying its positions

parameters.name: EMAPeriod
parameters.description: EMA周期，用于判断趋势方向

parameters.name: TrendTF
parameters.description: 趋势判断使用的时间周期

parameters.name: RSILower
parameters.description: RSI做多阈值（RSI高于此值确认多头动量）
parameters.description_en: RSI long threshold (above confirms bullish momentum)

parameters.name: RSIUpper
parameters.description: RSI做空阈值（RSI低于此值确认空头动量）
parameters.description_en: RSI short threshold (below confirms bearish momentum)

parameters.name: PauseDuringNews
parameters.description: 是否在新闻时段暂停交易

parameters.name: MarketCloseHour
parameters.description: 市场休市小时，该小时不交易
parameters.description_en: Market closed hour, no trading during this hour

pros: 使用EMA和RSI双重过滤初始入场方向，避免逆势开仓
动态手数根据余额自动调整，资金管理有一定合理性
设有MaxRisk最大亏损限制，防止账户爆仓
新闻时段和收盘时段暂停交易，规避高波动风险
使用MagicNumber区分持仓，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Uses dual EMA and RSI filters for initial entry direction, avoiding counter-trend openings
Dynamic lot sizing automatically adjusts based on account balance, providing proportional risk management
MaxRisk parameter caps maximum allowed loss, preventing total account blowout
Pauses trading during news hours and market close hour, avoiding high-volatility periods
Uses MagicNumber to tag positions, preventing conflicts with other EAs
cons: 网格加仓使用1.2倍马丁格尔乘数，逆势加仓会导致亏损头寸越来越大
所有订单都没有设置止损价格，完全依赖程序化平仓，若OnTick未执行则无保护
RSI做多阈值55和做空阈值45逻辑反直觉，阈值区间过窄，可能频繁误判方向
最大网格层数硬编码为3，无法通过参数调整，灵活性不足
新闻暂停仅基于固定小时判断，无法适配不同经济日历和实际新闻时间
没有新K线检查，每个Tick都会评估入场条件，可能导致重复下单
cons_en: Grid pyramiding uses a 1.2x martingale multiplier, causing increasingly large positions against the trend which amplifies losses exponentially
No individual stop-loss prices are set on any order, relying entirely on programmatic closing via OnTick which fails if the terminal disconnects
RSI thresholds are counterintuitive with buy threshold at 55 and sell threshold at 45, the narrow gap may cause frequent misjudgment of direction
Maximum grid layers are hard-coded to 3 with no parameter to adjust, limiting flexibility
News pause is based only on a fixed hour, unable to adapt to different economic calendars or actual news release times
No new bar check is implemented, every tick triggers evaluation which could lead to redundant or rapid-fire order attempts
improvements: 增加新K线判断逻辑，避免同一根K线内重复开仓和加仓
为每个订单设置止损价格，防止终端断连时无法程序化平仓导致无限亏损
将最大网格层数改为可配置参数，并添加总持仓手数上限检查
增加点差过滤，避免在点差过大时开仓，特别是新闻前后和流动性低的时段
improvements_en: Add new bar detection logic to prevent repeated entries and grid additions within the same candle
Set stop-loss price levels on each individual order to protect against terminal disconnection scenarios where programmatic closing cannot execute
Make maximum grid layers a configurable parameter and add a total exposure lot size cap check
Add spread filtering to avoid opening positions during high-spread conditions, especially before/after news and during low-liquidity sessions

risk_points: 马丁格尔式网格加仓在逆势行情中会快速放大亏损，3层1.2倍加仓后最大手数可达基础手数的1.728倍
所有订单无止损价格，若MT5终端与服务器断连，程序化平仓逻辑无法执行，持仓将无限暴露于市场风险中
没有新K线检查机制，可能在极短时间内反复触发入场逻辑
MaxRisk以固定美元值设定而非百分比，随着账户增长风险比例会变化
risk_points_en: Martingale-style grid pyramiding rapidly amplifies losses in adverse markets, with 3 layers at 1.2x multiplier reaching 1.728x base lot on the final layer
No stop-loss prices on any order means if the MT5 terminal disconnects from the server, programmatic closing logic cannot execute, leaving positions fully exposed to unlimited market risk
No new bar check mechanism could cause rapid-fire repeated entry triggers within extremely short timeframes
MaxRisk is set as a fixed dollar value rather than a percentage, causing the risk proportion to vary as the account grows or shrinks

All positions are closed when combined profit reaches a target or loss exceeds a maximum risk threshold.
